description: Fork of exp174 (val_bpb=1.6478). TWO changes: (1) replace unembedder middle Linear+GELU with SmoothLUT (nap=10, tph=2048, n_sparse=32, out=1536) + SparseScatter. (2) replace each LUTBlock's V2D->D2V wrap with a plain LayerNorm(E). LN remains at start of unembedder right after concat. Initial run (with V2D/D2V) reached step 5400 bpb=1.7603 vs exp174 1.6790, gap +0.081 stable; archived as *_with_v2d. This re-run tests whether removing rank-canonicalization at block boundaries lets the smooth LUT unembedder learn richer real-valued features. Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
